description: Synthetic assessment rules; not Darwix policies.

rules.explanation: The requested amount is below the synthetic minimum.
rules.source_quote: The synthetic loan amount ranges from INR 100000 to INR 2000000. Requested amounts outside these limits require a human review and cannot be automatically qualified.

rules.explanation: The requested amount exceeds the synthetic maximum.
rules.source_quote: The synthetic loan amount ranges from INR 100000 to INR 2000000. Requested amounts outside these limits require a human review and cannot be automatically qualified.

rules.explanation: Business age does not meet the synthetic minimum.
rules.source_quote: The minimum business age is 24 months (two years) of operation. A business operating for 12 months does not meet this synthetic preliminary qualification rule.

rules.explanation: Annual turnover does not meet the synthetic minimum.
rules.source_quote: The minimum annual turnover is INR 1200000. Turnover must be confirmed by the applicant and verified against documents before a final lending decision.

rules.explanation: Service availability in this city requires human review.
rules.source_quote: The demo accepts businesses located in Demo City or Sample City. A location outside these cities requires human review because service availability is unverified.

rules.explanation: Existing borrowing requires a human affordability review.
rules.source_quote: An existing loan does not automatically disqualify an applicant. Existing borrowing and repayment obligations must be disclosed for a human affordability review.
